about: Every budget <App>'s perf scripts enforce (limits, read through shared-web/perf/'s budgetLimits()) and every number its docs show (metrics, rendered by `just <app> report`). Source forms are documented at the top of shared-web/scripts/report.ts.

ttfpOverBaseline.what: `check`: reference TTFP over perf/baseline.json's, as a fraction

wasmOverBaseline.what: `check`: app wasm (brotli) over the baseline's, as a fraction, unless a perf/budget-notes.md row accepts the size

overlayToleranceMs.what: every cold run: the panel's TTFP (and other load rows) against the page's own marks
